public_rationale: The forecast has no stated deadline. The research found is relevant to recursive self-improvement, but it does not establish the required link to the specified GPU buildout. No qualifying revenue measurement was found. Neither the passage of four months nor the absence of a verified event supports a permanent negative forecast.
limitations: The meaning of self-improvement materially affects what would count.
The financial limb lacks a measurement period and accounting basis.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The current GPU buildout will not produce a 'digital God', recursive self-improvement, or $600 billion+ in new revenue for current services.

statement.excerpt: Those millions of H100 and B200 and B300 GPUs are not going to usher in a digital God, they are not going to create recursive self-improvement, they are not going to be the fulcrum to adding $600 billion or more in brand new revenue to current services

from_speaker: millions of H100 and B200 and B300 GPUs
not going to usher in a digital God
not going to create recursive self-improvement
$600 billion or more in brand new revenue to current services
our_interpretation: The forecast concerns the GPU buildout described at publication, not all future computing hardware.
Recursive self-improvement means repeated autonomous improvements to an AI system's own capabilities or improvement process. It does not require a digital God.
The revenue limb concerns additional realized revenue attributable to those deployments. The speaker supplies neither a revenue measurement period nor an accounting basis.
The separate reference to 2030 does not clearly impose a deadline on this sentence.
Digital God has no independently testable definition here.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete record of the specified fleet's operational life establishes that neither testable outcome occurred. Mere non-occurrence by the evaluation date is insufficient, and the digital-God wording cannot independently be scored.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified demonstration of recursive self-improvement attributable to the specified deployments, or properly measured additional current-service revenue of at least $600 billion attributable to them.

evidence.explanation: The paper reports successive improvements to an agent's software while keeping its underlying models fixed. It identifies A100 evaluation hardware and does not establish attribution to the forecast's H100/B200/B300 deployments, so it is material contrary context rather than a decisive event.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A verified self-improvement demonstration attributable to the specified deployments could contradict the forecast. The revenue limb needs a defined period and accounting basis plus attributable realized revenue. Supporting the negative forecast would require a complete operational-lifetime record.
